key_insight: LLMs lose diagnostic accuracy when they must gather clinical information interactively rather than receive the full case upfront.
clinical_relevance: Assessing how models ask questions—not just interpret supplied findings—is important before considering real-world diagnostic use.
method: Introduced Hx2Dx ARENA with 1,000 simulated clinical encounters drawn from NEJM cases.
Modeled history taking, physical examination, and diagnostic workup.
Evaluated open- and closed-source LLMs across configurations and compared interactive with static performance.
evidence_signal: Every evaluated model performed worse interactively than with full-case input, while more targeted questioning and a more complete clinical picture were associated with better diagnosis.
watch_item: Performance on simulated, publication-derived cases does not establish safety or effectiveness in real clinical encounters.
paper_title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
